fields.description: Stable unique row identifier derived from dataset_id, pathway_id and participant_id
fields.name: record_id

fields.description: Foreign key to dataset_catalog.csv identifying the dataset this row belongs to
fields.name: dataset_id

fields.description: Foreign key to source_list.csv identifying the originating database
fields.name: source_id

fields.description: Foreign key to source_assets.csv identifying the downloaded source file
fields.name: asset_id

fields.description: Raw gene identifier as it appears in the source file before normalization
fields.name: gene_id_raw

fields.description: Canonical gene identifier after namespace normalization
fields.name: gene_id

fields.description: Namespace/authority for the gene identifier (e.g., ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol)
fields.name: gene_id_namespace

fields.description: Version suffix of the gene identifier when available (e.g., ENSG00000139618.14)
fields.name: gene_id_version

fields.description: Foreign key to sample_metadata.csv identifying the sample (GEO GSM accession)
fields.name: sample_id

fields.description: Original sample alias used in the source file's column header
fields.name: source_sample_alias

fields.description: Type of measurement (e.g., tximport_estimated_count, sample_metadata)
fields.name: measurement_type

fields.description: Semantic interpretation of the value (e.g., estimated_count, metadata_only)
fields.name: value_semantics

fields.description: Scale of the value (e.g., linear, log2, na for not-applicable)
fields.name: value_scale

fields.description: Whether the value has been normalized (true/false)
fields.name: is_normalized

fields.description: Whether the value is expected to be an integer (true/false)
fields.name: is_integer_expected

fields.description: Numeric expression measurement value parsed from the source file
fields.name: expression_value

fields.description: Unit of the expression value (e.g., estimated_count, tpm, fpkm)
fields.name: expression_unit

fields.description: Logical name of the source file within the asset (e.g., GSE178352_tximportCounts.txt)
fields.name: source_logical_file

fields.description: 1-based line number in the source file where this value appears
fields.name: source_line_number

fields.description: 0-based column index in the source file where this value appears
fields.name: source_column_index

fields.description: Column header name in the source file
fields.name: source_column_name

fields.description: Original string value as it appears in the source file before parsing
fields.name: source_raw_value
